text:
Jordan Sales: Quick help — Contoso SIG questionnaire. Security asked for question-by-question evidence for encryption, KMS, and controls. Need screenshots of KMS rotation policy in Console + SOC2 excerpt by EOD. Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ContosoSIG (edit). cc @Alex Chen @Maria Patel
Alex Chen: On it. I can grab KMS config and rotation screenshot from staging console. Q A.3 asks 'keys rotated at least annually' — our policy shows 90 days, will capture screenshot and policy clause.
Maria Patel: I'll pull the SOC2 scope PDF from Drive and redact customer names. Where to upload? Sales S3 or ticket attachment?
Jordan Sales: Upload to the Sales evidence bucket: s3://redwood-sales-evidence/contoso/sig/ and mark filename in the spreadsheet cell "SOC2-PDF-path". Use "for-review" prefix.
Sam K: Heads-up — for A.7 we need evidence of disk encryption on private deploys (full-disk and snapshot encryption). I can export host-level /etc/crypttab and installer checklist. Need cross-account read to the staging account to fetch snapshots. @Emily Rogers can you grant contoso-read?
Emily Rogers: Granted contoso-read to sam.k (IAM role). Also spun up a temporary presigned link to the staging KMS page (expires in 24h) :lock:
Jordan Sales: Perfect. Also SIG wants the exact policy text for "Key custody" — we have a canonical clause in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/security/kms-key-custody. Alex, can you copy the clause into the sheet under "A.2 evidence"?
Alex Chen: Done — pasted clause in rows 12-15 and added screenshot kms-rotation-2026-03-21.png. Also attached the console export JSON in the s3 folder. Sam, what's your plan for snapshot proofs?
Sam K: I'll run the snapshot verification script and include timestamped checksums + export of snapshot metadata. Will place outputs in s3://redwood-sales-evidence/contoso/snapshots/1890123456/ and add a README with commands used. Jordan, ok to expose that path for vendor review?
Jordan Sales: :thumbsup: that's fine. Make sure objects are private and presigned links only. Maria — once SOC2 is uploaded, redact and drop the exact s3 path in the spreadsheet cell.
Maria Patel: Uploaded SOC2_RED_2025.pdf to s3://redwood-sales-evidence/contoso/compliance/SOC2_2025_redacted.pdf and updated the sheet.
sec-bot: Automated check — detected 3 new objects in s3://redwood-sales-evidence/contoso/. Reminder: set object ACL to private and enable server-side KMS encryption.
Alex Chen: Confirmed ACL=private and sse:kms enabled on uploaded files.
Jordan Sales: Thanks everyone — I'll run through the SIG question set with the vendor tomorrow morning. If anything else pops up, ping this thread. Closing after vendor signoff. :pray:
